title: Preseason form — a capped, sample-scaled, decaying multiplier (Rel17 F7)
description: Built by scripts/build_preseason.py from ESPN seasontype=1 (preseason) FINAL box scores. Preseason snaps are NOT true performance: starters sit or play a series and everyone is avoiding contact. So `adj` is clamped to 1 +/- constants.preseason_cap, scaled by a sample weight built from OPPORTUNITIES (ESPN publishes no snap counts), and multiplied by a decay that is EXACTLY 0.0 once a player's team has constants.decay_games FINAL regular-season games. Ships at registry weight 0.0. An unreachable feed, an unplayed preseason window, or a missing decay basis produces available:false with a reason and an EMPTY players map — never a fabricated or silently stale number.

reason.description: Null when available; otherwise the honest reason the document is empty.

estimate.description: Always true. Preseason form is an estimate, never a measurement of real football.

caveat.description: MANDATORY label. No surface may render an adj without this sentence.

sample_basis.description: What the sample weight is actually measured in. ESPN's boxscore carries no participation data, so it is opportunities (pass attempts + rush attempts + targets), not snaps — and it must say so.

preseason_cap.description: Hard bound on |adj - 1|. Conservative by design; may not be raised without an owner decision.

preseason_games_seen.description: FINAL preseason games ingested. 0 with available:false.

max_rank_move.description: MEASURED: the largest within-position rank move any top-100 projected player would suffer if every adj were applied at FULL strength (ignoring the registry weight). The owner rule 'must never flip a ranking on its own', made a number instead of an assumption.

rank_guard_ok.description: max_rank_move <= constants.max_rank_move. The promotion gate must not grant this signal weight while it is false.

players.description: Keyed by ESPN player id ('espn-<id>'). Empty when available is false.

team.description: The team whose FINAL regular-season game count drives this row's decay: the player's current projected team when known, else the team he suited up for in the preseason.

preseason_games.description: FINAL preseason games in which THIS player has a box-score line — his games played, not his team's.

opportunities.description: pass attempts + rush attempts + targets. NOT snaps.

prior_season_points.description: Prior-season PPR points from data/player_history.json, or null when the player has no prior season — in which case adj is exactly 1.0 with reason 'no_baseline'.

ratio.description: Unclamped (preseason ppr/game) / (prior season points / 17). Null when no signal was computed. Kept visible so the clamp is auditable, never used directly.

signal.description: ratio clamped into [1 - cap, 1 + cap]. Null when no signal was computed.

adj.description: 1 + (signal - 1) * sample * decay. Hard-bounded by the cap; exactly 1.0 whenever reason is non-null or the decay has run out.

reason.description: Null when a real signal was computed; otherwise names why adj is exactly 1.0 ('no_baseline', 'no_preseason_opportunities').
